soundness_flags.label: ass:fixed-dimensions
soundness_flags.one_line: T>=2K+2 makes M at least square, not overidentified at equality; the cited source describes the strict more-rows-than-columns regime T>2(K+1).

soundness_flags.label: ass:tube-nondegeneracy
soundness_flags.one_line: “Angular section,” its weighted measure, and the choice/normalization of the boundary-compatible resolution are not defined, so this load-bearing uniform two-sided-tail condition is not presently checkable.

soundness_flags.label: def:gamma-estimator
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed inverse can fail on a positive-probability finite sample event; define a total estimator on singular samples (or a regularized inverse) before using cross-fitting and risk claims.

soundness_flags.label: def:oracle-estimator and thm:matched-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The estimator specifies neither bandwidth nor a total chartwise fitting/extrapolation rule, and the minimax claim mixes P-specific R-star with an unspecified whole-class worst-case risk; define atlas-indexed subclasses and explicit inf-sup risk/length functionals.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 28--31, equation (14), Assumption 8, equations (15)--(20), and discussion at p. 30
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines DeltaY=Gamma+MB+epsilon with E[epsilon|M]=0, identifies Gamma by the projector equation, identifies each coordinate through a truncated Moore--Penrose score, gives the finite-support plug-in estimator, and calls T>2(K+1) the case where M has more rows than columns.
The paper derives a normal limit at sqrt(N h_N), explains variance of order 1/(N h_N), and states the MSE-optimal bandwidth h_N*=C_0 N^(-1/3).

The article defines Hankel determinantal rings, records height n-t+1 and the next-minor singular locus, and proves rational singularities in characteristic zero; it does not study real probability tails or coordinate pseudo-inverse ratios.

The article studies algebraic stratification and stability of local-zeta-type integrals of polynomial numerator--denominator ratios; this supports its use as methodological substrate rather than as an occupying causal tail theorem.
The article links unbounded identifying weights to irregular, tail-dependent nonparametric rates, but does not derive a structured Hankel leverage tail or a matched panel lower experiment.

source_verification_receipts.version: Econometric Theory First View, published online 7 January 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes consistency, standard errors, many-slow-mover extensions, and higher-order bias reduction for a scalar slow-mover panel setting; it does not advertise a Hankel-chart or shared-Gamma procedure.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace ass:tube-nondegeneracy with a canonical, chart-independent finite list of sector masses/angle bounds computable from the defining support inequalities, and prove the advertised box/polytope examples satisfy it.
Define a total oracle procedure: deterministic chart resolution, local-polynomial bandwidths and kernels, boundary extrapolation rule, and a singular-sample fallback for Gamma.

State matched-frontier on explicitly defined fixed-atlas signature subclasses, with inf-estimator sup-law risk and honest-length functionals; then give the scalar T=2,K=0 reduction literally rather than through the ambiguous phrase “scalar increment.”
Rename ass:fixed-dimensions as an at-least-square condition, or impose T>=2K+3 wherever genuine overidentification is required.
